北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京多云，体感 2℃ 稍凉，记得添衣保暖哦。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy and feels a bit cool at 2℃. Remember to dress warmly!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪有雨体感 1℃，北风 3级 寒冷，出门带伞多穿衣。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has rain and feels cold at 1℃ with a 3-level north wind. Take an umbrella and dress warmly.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海小雨，体感 3℃ 较冷，记得带伞，小心着凉。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai has light rain and feels quite cold at 3℃. Remember your umbrella and take care not to catch a cold.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光明媚 28℃，天气暖和，注意补水防晒哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and warm at 28℃. Remember to hydrate and protect yourself from the sun!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴朗 28℃，体感舒适，户外活动很不错哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny at 28℃ and feels comfortable. It's a great day for outdoor activities!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州小雨体感-2℃，很湿冷，务必多穿几件保暖。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has light rain and feels very cold and damp at -2℃. Be sure to dress in layers to stay warm.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天体感-1℃，湿气重，注意防寒，别感冒了。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy and feels cold at -1℃ with high humidity. Pay attention to staying warm and avoid catching a cold.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天 17℃，体感 14℃，早晚温差大，注意加减衣物。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy at 17℃, feeling like 14℃. Mind the temperature difference between morning and evening, dress accordingly.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天体感-4℃，伴 3级 风，湿冷刺骨，一定要保暖。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy and feels bone-chilling cold at -4℃ with a level 3 wind. Be sure to keep warm!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 1℃ 凉意十足，外出记得多添衣。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and feels quite cool at 1℃. Remember to add more layers when going out.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天 16℃，体感 14℃ 舒适，早晚小心温差哦。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy at 16℃, feeling comfortable at 14℃. Be mindful of temperature changes between morning and evening.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴天，体感-6℃ 寒冷，风力 3级，务必全副武装。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny and feels freezing at -6℃ with a level 3 wind. Be sure to bundle up completely!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴天体感-5℃，风力 3级，外出记得戴帽子手套。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny and feels like -5℃ with a level 3 wind. Remember your hat and gloves when going out.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗 20℃，体感 14℃ 舒适，紫外线强注意防晒。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny at 20℃, feeling comfortable at 14℃. UV is strong, remember sun protection.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门大雾，能见度低，体感 15℃ 稍凉，注意交通安全。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen has heavy fog and low visibility, feeling a bit cool at 15℃. Please pay attention to traffic safety.
厦门.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴天体感-3℃，北风 3级，注意防风保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and feels like -3℃ with a level 3 north wind. Remember to protect yourself from wind and cold.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴天，体感-8℃ 寒风凛冽， 4级 风，多穿别着凉。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny and feels bitterly cold at -8℃ with a level 4 wind. Dress warmly and avoid catching a cold.
